configOptions.name: Announce available tools
configOptions.description: List the session's MCP tools at the start of every turn. Turning it off saves the notification, not every tools/list: a turn still lists the servers it calls, because a tool call's kind comes from their annotations.

options.name: Stop
options.description: End the turn at the failed call.

content.text: The prompt is empty, so it names no tool to run. Each text block must be a JSON object naming an MCP tool: {"tool": "<name>", "arguments": {...}, "server": "<name>"}. "arguments" defaults to {}; "server" may be omitted only when the session opened exactly one MCP server.
